description: This file defines the DestroyPurgeStrategy class, which extends PurgeStrategy and implements a method to purge records related to an employee based on employee number, by retrieving matching records and removing them via the EntityManager.

classes.name: DestroyPurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class responsible for deleting database records related to an employee, implementing the purge functionality.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes all records related to the specified employee number by fetching matching entities and removing each via the EntityManager.
